info.title: TheTaxi Driver Mobile API
info.description: Complete canonical Driver Mobile API contract. Assignment projections expose server-owned service capabilities and traveler/contact identity. Pricing is visible only when the driver must collect payment. Complete-trip calculates and stores the final amount first; cash collection uses the separate collect-payment endpoint only when `payment.collection_required` is true.

get.description:
Retrieve driver location history using the same endpoint for both live and replay use cases.

Default behavior:
- Returns active session route points.
- If no active session exists, returns the latest session route points.

Optional filters:
- assignment_id: get trip-specific route points (works after trip end)
- session_id: get route points for a specific session
- from/to: recorded_at time window
- limit: max points (1-10000)

Each route point includes assignment_id so maps can distinguish trip-linked vs general movement.

get.description: Canonical endpoint: get trip status for a specific assignment. Response includes all generated route stops in `stops`, the next actionable stop in `current_stop`, and assignment-level `allowed_actions`. Use each stop `id` for stop action endpoints. Use `booking_stop_id`, `type_sequence`, and `display_label` to identify the exact booking pickup/dropoff in the mobile UI. This endpoint is shared by fixed-route, multi-stop, and open-package chauffeur hires; mobile behavior is selected from trip_mode, destination_known, and is_multi_stop in the assignment/status response.

post.description: Multi-stop endpoint. Marks the current route stop as arrived. Use `current_stop.id` from trip status as `{{stop_id}}`; `booking_stop_id`, `type_sequence`, and `display_label` identify which pickup/dropoff this is. Previous stops must already be completed or skipped.

Multi-stop endpoint. Completes an arrived pickup stop as picked_up. Use only when `current_stop.type` is `pickup` and `current_stop.status` is `arrived`; display `current_stop.display_label` such as `Pickup 2` in mobile.

Multi-stop endpoint. Completes an arrived dropoff stop as dropped_off. Use only when `current_stop.type` is `dropoff` and `current_stop.status` is `arrived`; display `current_stop.display_label` such as `Drop-off 1` in mobile.

Multi-stop endpoint. Skips the current pickup/dropoff stop. Skipped stops are terminal and allow the driver to move to the next stop. Use `booking_stop_id` and `display_label` in logs/UI to show exactly which booking stop was skipped.

Canonical endpoint: complete trip for a specific assignment. Backend calculates/stores the final hire amount and returns payment instructions. If `payment.collection_required` is true, call collect-payment next. This endpoint is shared by fixed-route, multi-stop, and open-package chauffeur hires; mobile behavior is selected from trip_mode, destination_known, and is_multi_stop in the assignment/status response.
